subject: TARGET CLAIM: PanelEngine peer-role coherence across logical-display remap
body: WORKSTREAM_ID=ws-performance-rd-panel-role-remap-coherence-20261002. WORKSTREAM_STATE=CLAIMED. STARTING_MAIN_SHA=7a612a0fe3181768f548a1ec78d2c3ee5938a339. CLAIMED_BOUNDARY=FoldOverlayService.syncDisplays/PanelEngine hasLiveInnerElsewhere/concurrentCover role observation when existing logical display IDs change physical geometry. Goal: remove evaluation-order dependence without changing privileged Gen2 ownership or generic multi-panel behavior; preserve live remap safety and build deterministic tests/prototype. Current proof: cached peer role can yield max cover frost at 150deg instead of flat concurrent-cover result solely based on engine iteration order. Explicit exclusions: semantic device-state re-close, hinge-ingress coalescing, shell lease authority, terminal/native handoff, frame/content freshness, angle authority, app-process recovery, and production GitHub writes.
